item.title: 0.1.0-beta.3
item.description:
Shan Early Beta

Write notes, explore connected ideas, and get help from your AI agent.

What's new
- English installation instructions and in-app release notes.
- English default workflow instructions. AI responses continue to use the language of your notes.
- Fixed URL-based note titles being cut off at the first period.
- Automatically generated duplicate note titles now receive a numbered suffix, so saving no longer fails because of a name collision. Existing note paths are unchanged.

Installation and updates
- Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 26 or later.
- Drag Shan to Applications, then open it.
- This early beta has not been notarized by Apple. If macOS blocks the first launch, open System Settings > Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway.
- Choose Shan > Check for Updates… to install future updates.
